bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
stage="$repo/.worktrees/menu-hotfix-runtime-dual-20261115"
newtag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:menu-hotfix-0bbf7c6
test "$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse HEAD)" = 57955cd68bb39626ebbca38d44b7bb034da6dc05 || exit 74
test "$(sha256sum "$stage/gaybbs.mjs" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = 76ccecd409e9c6ec0515a3f6d8f72063b26ffedaa32c1e47cd8e7b7054109d62 || exit 74
test "$(sha256sum "$stage/publishMenuPanels.mjs" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = 46f007a7a15fefd918d2bd443e492cac2e7542c19b7bd2aac5382b1101f7f036 || exit 74
newid="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$newtag")" || { echo CANDIDATE_IMAGE_MISSING; exit 74; }
mapfile -t existing < <(docker ps -aq --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=deploy --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs)
test "${#existing[@]}" -eq 1 || { echo SERVICE_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED; exit 64; }
old="${existing[0]}"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Name}}' "$old")" = /deploy-gaybbs-1 || exit 74
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$old")" = true || exit 74
oldid="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$old")"
project="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' "$old")"
files="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}}' "$old")"
base="${files%%,*}"
test -f "$base" || { echo BASE_COMPOSE_UNAVAILABLE; exit 74; }
docker compose -p "$project" -f "$base" config --quiet || exit 74
docker image tag "$oldid" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-before-menu-20261115
cat > "$stage/live-override.yaml" <<'YAML'
services:
  gaybbs:
    image: gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:menu-hotfix-0bbf7c6
    pull_policy: never
YAML
cat > "$stage/rollback-override.yaml" <<'YAML'
services:
  gaybbs:
    image: gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-before-menu-20261115
    pull_policy: never
YAML
docker compose -p "$project" -f "$base" -f "$stage/live-override.yaml" config --quiet || exit 74
changed=0
rollback(){ rc=$?;trap - ERR;set +e;if test "$changed" = 1; then docker compose -p "$project" -f "$base" -f "$stage/rollback-override.yaml" up --no-build --no-deps -d gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo MENU_ROLLBACK=ATTEMPTED || echo MENU_ROLLBACK=FAILED;fi;exit "$rc"; }
trap rollback ERR
changed=1
docker compose -p "$project" -f "$base" -f "$stage/live-override.yaml" up --no-build --no-deps -d gaybbs
sleep 8
mapfile -t now < <(docker ps -aq --filter label=com.docker.compose.project="$project" --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs)
test "${#now[@]}" -eq 1 || { echo COUNT_FAILED; false; }
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "${now[0]}")" = true || { echo NOT_RUNNING; false; }
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "${now[0]}")" = "$newid" || { echo IMAGE_MISMATCH; false; }
trap - ERR
echo GAYBBS_MENU_IMAGE_DEPLOY=PASS
echo NEW_IMAGE_ID=$newid
echo GAYBBS_READY="$(docker logs --since 3m "${now[0]}" 2>&1 | grep -q 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY' && echo PASS || echo NOT_OBSERVED)"
echo USERBOT_ACTIVE="$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
